basic_info.description: Rarely does a home come to market that embodies both natural elegance and a refined sense of livability, seamlessly blending robust design with subtle beauty.  Nestled on a sunlit, iconic street in Glen Park celebrated for its inventive architecture and steps from the vibrant village and serene Canyon Light Bridge House is an extraordinary property. Defined by masterful proportions and exceptional craftsmanship, this home is a study in artisanal simplicity. Its signature feature, a striking bridge that connects the house to the street, echoes in the interior with a dramatic light bridge that illuminates the soaring spaces, functional interiors, and outdoor areas.
